evidenceBoundary: Public web search/open extracts and publisher descriptions only. Official identity corroborated through Sakura AI, LLC in the privacy policy and App Store seller plus reciprocal sakura.fm links. No accounts, sign-in, purchases, generated chat, inference calls, browser automation, production access, device tests, or application source inspection. Mira is user-authored content, not official documentation; its returned extract was cached several months earlier. Unknown means not established, not absent. Benefits and proposals are explicitly inferences, not tested outcomes.

strengths.mechanism: Explore combines search, thematic tags, portraits, premise descriptions, and creator attribution.
strengths.benefitInference: Users may choose a desired story before service configuration; discovery quality was not tested.

strengths.mechanism: Public character pages separate a greeting, description, scenario, and creator.
strengths.benefitInference: Readers may judge premise and opening voice before investing in a conversation. Mira is a user-authored example, not official instructions.

strengths.mechanism: Diamond markets Fusion Mode as response alternatives for each message.
strengths.benefitInference: Alternative continuations may let writers select tone or direction without drafting a replacement. Selection, persistence, and branching are unverified.

strengths.mechanism: Official App Store distribution documents iPhone and iPad compatibility.
strengths.benefitInference: Dedicated mobile access may support frequent use. No installation, touch, keyboard, synchronization, accessibility, or parity tests were performed.

characterOnboarding.note: Public catalog search, tags, descriptions and example greeting/scenario/creator are visible in extracts. Publisher advertises creation, but create page shows sign-in prompts; editor fields and import formats remain unknown.

storyOrganization.note: Chat History exists as a titled route but its unauthenticated extract shows sign-in prompts. Exact-story continuation, multiple stories per character, archives and naming are not established.

editRetryBranch.note: Fusion Mode advertises multiple response options. Editing, explicit regeneration, branch creation, selection semantics and preserved alternatives are not established.

memoryLore.note: Dragonfruit advertises better memory; Infinite advertises Infinite Memory. Context limits, memory editing/retrieval, summaries and lorebooks are not established. No retention guarantee is verified.

promptTransparency.note: Public description/scenario and greeting show author content only. Assembled model prompts, hidden instructions and context composition are not established.

modelConnections.note: Sakura+ names Dragonfruit and Glowing Dragonfruit. Actual selection workflow, provider connections, API keys and local endpoints are not established.

advancedControls.note: No inspected primary source establishes sampler, context-budget or other expert generation controls. Unknown does not mean absent.

groupRoleplay.note: Native multi-character orchestration is not established. Multi-character fiction would not prove a group-chat mechanism.

imagesVoice.note: Infinite marketing associates Glowing Dragonfruit with images. Generation controls, image handling and voice configuration are not established.

mobile.note: App Store ID 6467520779 names Sakura AI, LLC and documents iPhone/iPad compatibility. No device, layout, touch, accessibility, synchronization or parity testing.

portability.note: Character-card import/export, conversation export, backups and migration fidelity were not established. Sign-in-bound pages do not prove absence.

selfHosting.note: Reviewed public pages describe a hosted product; no official source repository or self-hosting procedure was established. This is not evidence that self-hosting is impossible.

tradeoffs.note: Creation and Chat History show sign-in prompts in public extracts, limiting workflow verification.

Subscription tiers bundle model, memory, response-choice and image claims. Free-message applications use Discord and the page acknowledges daily message limits. No prices are reported; comparative model quality was not tested.
Support page directs users to Discord. This establishes a help route, not draft preservation, in-chat recovery or response times.
Some catalog descriptions are very long in extracted text, which may burden premise scanning. No rendered layout was inspected.
Privacy policy states January 06, 2024 as its update date. Reviewed evidence does not establish chat-specific privacy, local storage or retention guarantees.

unknowns: Character import formats and actual creation editor fields.
Exact conversation continuation, separate story identity, archive, checkpoints and naming.
Message editing, regeneration, branch creation and preservation of Fusion Mode alternatives.
Memory limits, memory inspection/editing, lorebooks, retrieval and summaries.
Assembled prompt inspection, provider/local connections, samplers and context controls.
Native group orchestration, voice setup, image generation controls and image portability.
Mobile usability, synchronization, accessibility and feature parity; no device tests.
Failure recovery, draft retention, outage handling and support response times.
Character/conversation exports, migration fidelity, public source repository and self-hosting.

reusablePatterns.proposal: Keep a short premise and creator attribution beside character selection; expand long definitions separately.
reusablePatterns.rationaleInference: Helps readers choose a premise without scanning the full definition.

reusablePatterns.proposal: Separate character description, scenario and opening message in a profile preview.
reusablePatterns.rationaleInference: Helps readers distinguish identity, situation and starting voice.

reusablePatterns.proposal: Consider optional response alternatives and define selection/preservation explicitly.
reusablePatterns.rationaleInference: May support authorial direction; Fusion Mode does not establish branching.

reusablePatterns.proposal: Disclose model, memory, image and voice capabilities and limits at service selection while keeping advanced controls reachable.
reusablePatterns.rationaleInference: May make capability choice clearer. This is a proposal, not evidence that the fork lacks native controls or that Sakura documents voice setup.

doNotCopy.pattern: Absolute memory promises without inspectable memory or limits.
doNotCopy.reason: Marketing does not verify recall quality or retention guarantees.

doNotCopy.pattern: Discord as the only recovery instruction.
doNotCopy.reason: Users need actionable errors and retained drafts inside the workspace. Sakura actual in-chat recovery remains unknown.
